name: Ear Training Crash Course
instructions: Build on yesterday with slightly harder exercises -- try identifying whether a chord sounds "major" (bright) or "minor" (darker) by ear.
Practice a little daily rather than one long session; ear training is one of the slowest-building skills in music.
Do not worry about being wrong often -- even experienced musicians keep training this skill throughout their playing.
Watch today's crash course video for more structured ear training.
